items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: And Eva and come up there, he wasn't playing that night, but he come up there and played something for me.

ctx.x: I didn't hear them play together, but I remembered him one time because we played at Lafayette, Louisiana. I went with old Andrew Foster when I had my little band. And Eva and come up there, he wasn't playing that night, but he come up there and played something for me. He was a straight horn player, strong, but wasn't a, you know, not a whole lot of flesh. He was a straight, strong horn player. I see.
Who was this Foster fellow? What Foster?
